tools.name: search_border_crossings
tools.description: Use this when the person names a border crossing, a town at a border, two countries or an airport and you need its id. Not for crossings around a place: use list_border_crossings_near. Answers border crossings and airports' passport control whose names, towns or countries match the words in any orde

tools.name: list_border_crossings_near
tools.description: Use this when the person asks what crossings are around a place or around them. Not for which one to take: use find_best_crossing. Answers the border crossings and airports nearest a town or crossing named in near, or lat and lon, each with its distance in km and its car lane's wait now; at most 20.

tools.name: get_border_wait
tools.description: Use this when the person asks how long the wait or the line is at a crossing or an airport now. Not for another hour or day: use get_usual_wait. Answers one crossing or airport now: each direction, and in it every lane (cars, trucks, coaches, walking, NEXUS, SENTRI, Ready Lane, FAST, or the airport'

tools.name: get_usual_wait
tools.description: Use this when the person asks when to cross, which hour or day is quiet, or how long it usually takes. Not for the wait right now: use get_border_wait. tools.name: find_time_to_leave
tools.description: Use this when the person must be across a border by a time and asks when to get in line. through_by is a time in their words (16:00, 4 pm tomorrow). tools.name: find_best_crossing
tools.description: Use this when the person asks which border crossing to take from where they are or will be. into is the country they are going to. tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Use this when the person asks to tell Borders something: a wrong wait, a missing crossing, an idea. Only their words, never include the conversation. Not for questions about a wait: answer from the other tools.
